name: Quill Spray

source.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens The Mwangi Expanse

prerequisites: quillcoat shisk or quill unarmed attack
text:
Frequency once per day

---
You can launch a mass of quills at opponents. You spray quills in a 30-foot cone, dealing ceil(@actor.level/2)d8 piercing damage. Each creature in the area must attempt a basic Reflex save saving throw against the higher of your class DC or spell DC. On a critical failure, a creature also takes ceil(@actor.level/2) bleed damage. At 11th level and every even level thereafter, the piercing damage increases by 1d8 and the persistent bleed damage increases by 1.

---
Note The feat does not specify the type of saving throw required. A reflex saving throw has been added, in line with Barbed Quills.
